page_title: DAR 0-6 AUG | Darmstadt v Augsburg 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
89' Augsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' 0 - 6 Amazing piece of skill! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is!
84' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' The ball is cleared after Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Darmstadt.
81' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
80' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
79' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Arne Engels (Augsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

78' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
75' Pep Biel (Augsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Substitution. Sebastian Polter makes way for Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Jeffrey Gouweleeuw can be given a rest.
74' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) replaces Luca Pfeiffer.
73' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
72' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
71' The manager makes a subsitution with Dion Beljo (Augsburg) coming on for Ermedin Demirovic.
70' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.

65' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.

64' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt towards the bottom left corner fails to beat Finn Dahmen, who makes a sensational save.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
62' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Augsburg win a corner.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kristijan Jakic will be replaced by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arne Maier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pep Biel (Augsburg).
59' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Finn Dahmen is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
58' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

57' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Augsburg will take a corner.
57' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) touches the ball with his hand.
56' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
53' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

52' Augsburg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' A substitution has been made. Fredrik Jensen goes off and Arne Engels (Augsburg) comes on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Darmstadt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+2' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
45' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
44' Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the middle of the goal and Finn Dahmen easily makes the save.
42' Darmstadt fail to score from a corner as Finn Dahmen (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
41' Fabian Holland is being substituted because of an injury. Torsten Lieberknecht sends Andreas Muller (Darmstadt) on the pitch.
40' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
33' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman signals a throw-in for Augsburg.
32' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' Arne Maier (Augsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' 0 - 5 Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
28' A lofted pass finds Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
27' Here is a change. Jannik Muller is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt).
27' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) will replace Klaus Gjasula.
25' 0 - 4 Goal! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.

23' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen pulls off a brilliant save.
23' Arne Maier (Augsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
20' 0 - 3 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:3.
19' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
19' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.
18' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Arne Maier (Augsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

12' 0 - 2 A superb goal from great team play! Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
11' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
10' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
9' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Julian Justvan (Darmstadt).
6' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
5' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
4' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Finn Dahmen is alert and denies him.
3' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 0:1.
1' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
